extract: Built-in Jobs Contributor and Operator match listSecrets through Microsoft.App/jobs/*/action. Start accepts an optional execution template override (images, commands, environment variables); starter can use job secrets and managed identities available to containers. Microsoft's custom-role example names jobs/read, start/action, stop/action, stop/execution/action, executions/read, execution/read and managedEnvironments/read.
limitations: Documentation evidence only. No Azure authorization or live operation tested.
